title: A derivative-free particle method for optimization in Hilbert spaces
summary: We introduce a stochastic interacting particle system in separable Hilbert spaces together with its associated mean-field formulation. The model is shown to retain the characteristic consensus-driven structure of classical Consensus-Based Optimization, while accounting for the analytical challenges of infinite-dimensional dynamics. We establish well-posedness of the proposed dynamics and analyze the associated consensus mechanism.
